summary: Vulcan Materials Company produces and supplies construction aggregates in the United States. It operates through three segments: Aggregates, Asphalt, and Concrete. The company provides crushed stone, sand and gravel, sand, and other aggregates for use in construction and maintenance of highways, streets, and other public works, as well as in the construction of housing and commercial, industrial, and other nonresidential facilities; aggregates that are used as ballast for construction and maintenance of railroad tracks; riprap and jetty stones for use in erosion control along roads and waterwa
thesis: Vulcan Materials Company (Holdi memiliki fundamental lemah (skor 47/100) dengan keunggulan utama di kesehatan keuangan (67) dan kualitas bisnis (50). Titik lemahnya ada di valuasi (31). Gabungan model DCF, multiple sektor, dan target analis menghasilkan nilai wajar $215.16 — potensi turun 23.2% dalam ~12 bulan (keyakinan rendah). Kondisi teknikal cukup (53/100). Risiko geopolitik rendah; berpeluang diuntungkan tema Reshoring & Kebijakan Industri AS.
